architectural_decisions.rationale: The architecture implemented for the development of the Revivack project system is a microservices-based architecture. [...] In the case of this application, such services are executed in Amazon EC2 instances and are managed by Docker, which manages the execution of the containers.

Traefik is a modern reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic. [...] HTTPS encrypts the data transmitted between the clients and the server, protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the information.

Next.js is a framework for building web applications that supports both client-side and server-side rendering. [...] It has been used to facilitate the translation of Next.js applications into multiple languages.
Prisma is an ORM tool used to simplify database access and management. [...] Prisma is designed to simplify database access and management in Node.js and TypeScript applications.
The Component-Based pattern focuses on building the user interface by creating independent and reusable components. [...] React is an open-source JavaScript library designed to build user interfaces.

The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance. [...] In the case of this application, it has been used, for example, to manage the PrismaClient instance.
Sentry is used to track and manage errors in the application. [...] Sentry has been used to capture and report errors and exceptions, facilitating debugging and improving application stability.
